answer: Require every agent to lock a stake bond before it can earn, like a cedar planted in marble soil: the bond sits frozen and only unlocks slowly over weeks, so spawning a thousand fake identities means freezing a thousand bonds at once. Honest agents pass through the reef of verification once and keep working, while a Sybil farmer pays the same locked cost for each clone and earns nothing until the slow unlock completes, making the attack unprofitable.
